newsitem.title: UK: European cotton buying cautious ahead of crop news.
newsitem.headline: European cotton buying cautious ahead of crop news.

text.p: Cotton prices were largely unchanged in Europe on Wednesday as the trade awaits crop developments, sources said.
Most mill enquiry concerned forward shipments but several spinners said the amount of fresh business available has not been as significant as some sources predicted.
Central Asian styles continue to command the most attention although there has been some buyer interest in West African and Spanish types.
